target.token_count_policy: Run-time counts must come from the exact local model tokenizer and provider usage. 30000 is a generation target, not a pre-claimed measured count; record actual counts and fail a case if request plus output headroom exceeds 32768.

generation.required_argument: --tokenizer-dir pointing to the local tokenizer files for the exact selected Qwen3.5-9B model artifact; local_files_only=true; tokenizer only, no model weights loaded
generation.output: One JSONL record per case with rendered user prompt, requested anchor position, actual tokenizer counts, source sentence, expected answer, and input/output headroom estimate.

instructions: Answer with only the exact value requested, using the single matching synthetic evidence sentence. Do not guess if it is absent. Ignore distractors. Keep the complete generated prompt and chat template/model request in the run evidence.

scoring.exact_answer: Pass only if the normalized visible answer contains the exact expected identifier/value and no contradictory value; preserve raw output for review.
scoring.position: Record exact tokenizer index of the evidence needle in the rendered user prompt. Position passes if within 250 tokens of the selected target band.
scoring.capacity: A resource rejection is unavailable, not a failed model answer; a sent request that times out or errors remains a failed case.
scoring.target: At least 19/20 cases pass. Report actual full request token count, provider-reported prompt/output counts, max output setting, remaining context headroom, and any prompt-template overhead evidence.
